name: Surface Tessellation from Iso-Contours
definition: A method to represent iso-surfaces by generating polygonal surfaces from stacks of 2D contours on consecutive slices of parallel planes within a data volume.
summary: Surface Tessellation from Iso-Contours generates 3D polygonal meshes by triangulating consecutive 2D contour slices, differing from voxel-based methods by operating on explicit boundary data rather than scalar field samples.
